name: Claire Hikari no Densetsu Middleland Part
original_name: クレール光の伝説ミッドランド編
source: It depicts the exploits of Princess Claire and her companion Bright as they infiltrate Middleland, which is under attack by a horde of orcs.
translation: It depicts the exploits of Princess Claire and her companion Bright as they infiltrate Middleland, which is under attack by a horde of orcs.
